name: Huang Jin Xiang
source:
The protagonist, [Ye Yun], moves to a big city after graduating from university and lives with his partner for three months. His life seems perfect, but Ye Yun is often drawn into a strange dream.

As his mind gradually erodes, he begins to see hallucinations that overlap with reality... The supernatural and a serial killer in the city seem to be intricately linked to his dreams from behind the scenes.

[From [url=https://xlkw.itch.io/hjx]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主人公【叶云】大学毕业后搬到大城市，与伴侣一起生活了三个月。生活看似完美，叶云却时常陷入奇异的梦境。

随着他的思想逐渐侵蚀，他开始看到与现实重叠的幻觉……城市中的超自然现象和连环杀手似乎在幕后与他的梦想有着千丝万缕的联系。

[来自[url=https://xlkw.itch.io/hjx]Itch.io[/url]]
